docs.summary: Which response this filter has. Changing it re-picks the coefficient set and leaves the delay state alone, so a live filter can change shape without restarting.
Cutoff or centre frequency, clamped to the range the coefficients stay stable over.
Resonance. Clamped away from zero, which the coefficients divide by.
Shelf or peak gain in decibels. Negative cuts, positive boosts. Only the Lowshelf, Highshelf and Peak types use it.
